crossRefs.note: For God commanded, ‘Honor your father and your mother,’ and, ‘He who speaks evil of father or mother, let him be put to…
“Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you devour widows’ houses, and as a pretense you make long prayers.…
For the Sadducees say that there is no resurrection, nor angel, nor spirit; but the Pharisees confess all of these.

translations.web: Then they understood that he didn’t tell them to beware of the yeast of bread, but of the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.
translations.bsb: Then they understood that He was not telling them to beware of the leaven used in bread, but of the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.
translations.kjv: Then understood they how that he bade them not beware of the leaven of bread, but of the doctrine of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.
translations.asv: Then understood they that he bade them not beware of the leaven of bread, but of the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.
